metrics.label: Games
metrics.desc: Games played.

metrics.label: Starts
metrics.desc: Games started (in net for the first event).

metrics.label: TOI (min)
metrics.desc: Minutes played.

metrics.label: Wins
metrics.desc: Decisions credited to the goalie with the most time in the game.

metrics.label: Losses
metrics.desc: Regulation losses.

metrics.label: OT / SO losses
metrics.desc: Overtime and shootout losses.

metrics.label: Shots against
metrics.desc: Shots on goal faced.

metrics.label: Unblocked attempts faced
metrics.desc: Unblocked shot attempts faced (shots on goal plus misses; empty-net attempts excluded): the sample behind GSAx / 100.

metrics.label: Goals against
metrics.desc: Goals allowed (empty-net goals excluded).

metrics.label: Save %
metrics.desc: Saves per shot on goal.

metrics.label: GAA
metrics.desc: Goals against per 60.

metrics.label: GSAx
metrics.desc: xG of the unblocked attempts faced minus goals allowed (positive = better).

metrics.label: GSAx / 60
metrics.desc: GSAx per 60 minutes.

metrics.label: GSAx / 100 attempts
metrics.desc: GSAx per 100 unblocked attempts faced.

metrics.label: dFSv%
metrics.desc: Unblocked save % minus expected unblocked save %.

metrics.label: Expected FSv%
metrics.desc: 1 minus mean xG per unblocked attempt faced (shot difficulty).

metrics.label: GSAx low danger
metrics.desc: GSAx on attempts with xG under 0.08.

metrics.label: GSAx medium danger
metrics.desc: GSAx on attempts with xG 0.08-0.20.

metrics.label: GSAx high danger
metrics.desc: GSAx on attempts with xG 0.20 or more.

metrics.label: Low-danger sv%
metrics.desc: Save % on low-danger shots on goal.

metrics.label: Medium-danger sv%
metrics.desc: Save % on medium-danger shots on goal.

metrics.label: High-danger sv%
metrics.desc: Save % on high-danger shots on goal.

metrics.label: GSAx wrist / snap
metrics.desc: GSAx on wrist and snap shots.

metrics.label: GSAx slap
metrics.desc: GSAx on slap shots.

metrics.label: GSAx tips
metrics.desc: GSAx on tips and deflections.

metrics.label: GSAx backhand
metrics.desc: GSAx on backhands.

metrics.label: GSAx 5v5
metrics.desc: GSAx at 5v5.

metrics.label: GSAx short-handed
metrics.desc: GSAx with the goalie's team short-handed.

metrics.label: 5v5 sv%
metrics.desc: Save % at 5v5.

metrics.label: PK sv%
metrics.desc: Save % short-handed.

metrics.label: Shots against / 60
metrics.desc: Shots on goal faced per 60.

metrics.label: xGA / 60
metrics.desc: Expected goals faced per 60 (difficulty of the workload).

metrics.label: xG per attempt
metrics.desc: Mean xG of the unblocked attempts faced.

metrics.label: High-danger share
metrics.desc: Share of unblocked attempts faced that were high danger.

metrics.label: Start share
metrics.desc: Share of the team's games started.

metrics.label: Back-to-back starts
metrics.desc: Starts on the second night of a back-to-back.

metrics.label: Quality start %
metrics.desc: Starts with sv% above the league average (or .885 on 20 shots or fewer).

metrics.label: Really bad starts
metrics.desc: Starts with sv% under .850.

metrics.label: Rebound rate
metrics.desc: Saves followed within 3 s by another attempt by the shooting team, per save.

metrics.label: GSAx (shrunk)
metrics.desc: GSAx regressed toward zero by its stabilisation constant.

metrics.label: GSAx (model)
metrics.desc: GSAx from the expected-goals model's own table (empty nets out).

metrics.label: Rink value (GAR)
metrics.desc: Goals above a replacement-level goalie.

metrics.label: Rink value (WAR)
metrics.desc: GAR in wins.

metrics.label: EDGE high-danger sv%
metrics.desc: NHL EDGE save % from high-danger areas.

metrics.label: EDGE mid-range sv%
metrics.desc: NHL EDGE save % from mid-range.

metrics.label: EDGE long-range sv%
metrics.desc: NHL EDGE save % from long range.
